gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-cantarell: Cantarell reads smoothly, its c tips pulled apart and its arches sitting true to the stems. Shantell Sans is the one for personality, a marker-wide mouth up top, while Cantarell just gets on with being easy to read.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-catamaran: Approachable curves run through Catamaran, loose and unclamped, while Shantell Sans above it holds a single pen width throughout. One draws attention; the other quietly carries the sentences.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-chakra-petch: Chakra Petch brings round, cupped letters drawn in a stroke that never changes width, under a wide-mouthed Shantell Sans heading. And over many lines that plain sans keeps going smoothly, never snagging the eye.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-chiron-hei-hk: A single nib width, wide-mouthed and hand-drawn, is what defines Shantell Sans. Chiron Hei HK sits beside it with a bracelet-open c, modern and tidy, so the loose heading gets a steady partner.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-commissioner: Expressive is the mood Shantell Sans sets, every stroke drawn at a fixed nib width with a wide, can-lid mouth. Commissioner follows with a smooth plain sans texture, so paragraphs would glide without any clogged curves.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-didact-gothic: Didact Gothic reads without snagging, since no bowl closes up and each stroke carries similar weight. And across a full page, Shantell Sans keeps its expressive streak up top while this body stays modern and smooth.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-dotgothic16: Shantell Sans is distinctive. DotGothic16 follows with wide channels into each counter and a tube-like thickness, so giving that body a little extra size would help its sans-serif dots stay legible.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-doto: Approachable, Doto leaves wide margins of space around each glyph and gives its round letters generous mouths, a nice foil to the marker-tip heading of Shantell Sans. Give Doto a bit more size.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-el-messiri: Mellow is how El Messiri feels, with a moderate thick-thin ratio and a wide slot between the c's two ends, set beneath Shantell Sans. The heading traces one thick thread; the sans body shapes gentle contrast.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-electrolize: Contemporary in feel, Electrolize has an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, set under Shantell Sans, whose curves and straights share a single width. Paragraphs in this sans-serif would feel crisp and modern.
